# Motion and scenes

Scenes animate nodes on scroll, on load or on interaction. Prefer recipes (`motion.listRecipes`, `motion.applyRecipe`) to hand-written scenes, and read `motion.diagnose` findings after every change.

[`motion.read`](#motionread) · [`motion.replace`](#motionreplace) · [`motion.delete`](#motiondelete) · [`motion.listRecipes`](#motionlistrecipes) · [`motion.applyRecipe`](#motionapplyrecipe) · [`motion.saveRecipe`](#motionsaverecipe) · [`motion.diagnose`](#motiondiagnose)

## motion.read

Read the draft scenes of a page: each scene with its id, trigger, entries and options, as motion.replace writes them. With a region's page id (region.read answers it) it reads that region's own scenes. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { scenes: ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: … \| …, start: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, end?: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, endAnchor?: { nodeId: …, part: …, region?: … },… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}
```

## motion.replace

Replace every scene of a page with `scenes` (at most 500; scene and entry ids unique, each scene's `pageId` the page and `versionId` "_draft"). Each scene is validated against the nodes of the page and of its header and footer: a target none of them holds, or a node id two of them hold (422 scene_target_ambiguous), is refused. With a region's page id (header, footer, above or below; region.read answers it) the scenes are the region's own: authored once, they play on every page that renders the region, and name the region's own nodes without `region` (any other target is refused, 422 motion_invalid; publish refuses one the same way, 422 scene_target_invalid), such as a header logo that swings on every page. For the common effects prefer motion.applyRecipe. A scene may repeat (`loop: { repeat: <1-1000> | "infinite", yoyo? }`, such as a logo that swings forever on load; refused, with the reason, on a scrubbed scroll, on a scroll scene with `catchUp`, on a scroll-direction trigger, and when infinite on a first-interaction gate). A scroll scene without scrub may catch up with the scroll (`catchUp: true`: its progress is never behind the scroll's own through its range, so a fast swipe lands it where the scroll is) and may take a `hysteresis` ({ value > 0, unit vh|px }: it leaves back only that far above its start, and its states turn off only that far past its end, so a scroll that settles on the threshold does not flip it); neither with scrub. A scene may follow the page's scroll direction (trigger `scroll-direction`: plays scrolling down and back up, or with `distance` follows the scroll and with `idleSnapMs` settles to the nearer end; `from` keeps it at its start until an anchor's edge meets the viewport, `holdWhile` keeps it there while `<html>` carries a data attribute). A keyframe entry on a text or richtext node may play on its laid-out lines or words (`split: { by: "lines" | "words", words? }`, `stagger` apart, `words` ms between the words of a line; any other target is refused, 422 motion_invalid with INVALID_SPLIT_TARGET; never split under reduced motion), and `staggerWithin` (ms) compresses the delays so the last item ends in that time. A scene's `pageState` { state, lockScroll?, controls? } sets `data-page-<state>="on"` on the page's <html> while its trigger is active (a click scene toggles it; Escape and a chosen link close it), which node styles read as `pg:[data-page-<state>="on"]` and `page-state` triggers follow. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `scenes` | ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: { nodeId: …, part?: …, region?: … } \| "viewport", start: { edge: "top" \| "center" \| "bottom", viewport: number ≥0 ≤1, offset?: { value: …, unit: … }, belowHeader?: true }, end?: { edge: "… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","scenes":[{"id":"menu-toggle","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","versionId":"_draft","trigger":{"type":"event","event":"click","source":{"nodeId":"burger01"}},"entries":[],"pageState":{"state":"menu-open","lockScroll":true,"controls":{"nodeId":"panel001"}}},{"id":"menu-in","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","versionId":"_draft","trigger":{"type":"page-state","state":"menu-open"},"entries":[{"id":"menu-in-1","sceneId":"menu-in","target":{"nodeId":"menuhead"},"keyframes":[{"offset":0,"opacity":0,"transform":{"y":"1em"}},{"offset":1,"opacity":1,"transform":{"y":"0"}}],"position":{"type":"absolute","ms":0},"duration":500,"easing":"smooth-out","split":{"by":"lines"},"stagger":80,"staggerWithin":400,"reducedMotion":"fade-only"}]},{"id":"bar-ride","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","versionId":"_draft","trigger":{"type":"scroll-direction","distance":{"value":60,"unit":"px"},"idleSnapMs":150,"holdWhile":{"name":"data-page-menu-open","value":"on"}},"entries":[{"id":"bar-ride-1","sceneId":"bar-ride","target":{"nodeId":"bar00001","region":"header"},"keyframes":[{"offset":1,"transform":{"y":"-60px"}}],"position":{"type":"absolute","ms":0},"easing":"linear","reducedMotion":"instant"}]},{"id":"logo-swing","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","versionId":"_draft","trigger":{"type":"event","event":"load","source":"page"},"loop":{"repeat":"infinite","yoyo":true},"entries":[{"id":"logo-swing-1","sceneId":"logo-swing","target":{"nodeId":"logo0001"},"keyframes":[{"offset":0,"transform":{"rotate":"-6deg"}},{"offset":1,"transform":{"rotate":"6deg"}}],"position":{"type":"absolute","ms":0},"duration":1200,"easing":"gentle"}]}]}
```

## motion.delete

Delete one scene of a page by `sceneId` (404 scene_not_found when the page has none with it); the other scenes stay. A scene write shares the page tree's revision, and publish copies the scenes with the page.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `sceneId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","sceneId":"scene-1"}
```

## motion.listRecipes

List the scene recipes a page can apply: the built-in recipes first, then the site's own. Each has a label and a description in Italian and English, and two to four knobs (a number, a choice, a list of words, a node or a distance in screens) with working defaults.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { recipes: ({ id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, description: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, source: "built-in" \| "site", knobs: ({ id: …, label: …, help?: …, kind: …, min: …, max: …, step?: …, default: …, unit?: … } \| { id: …, label: …, help?… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## motion.applyRecipe

Build a recipe's scenes on a page from its knobs (a knob left out takes its default; an element knob such as `target` has none and must be given) and replace the page's scenes built by the same recipe on the same target. The scenes carry the recipe meta (`recipe: { id, knobs, custom: false }`) and are validated like motion.replace. The snap recipe writes the page's scroll setting instead, so its batch also needs the `pages` base revision. An unknown recipe is 404 recipe_not_found; refused knobs are 422 recipe_knobs_invalid.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `recipeId` | string | yes |
| `knobs` | Record<string, number \| string (max 200) \| boolean \| string (max 200)[] (≤50) \| { nodeId: string, part?: string (max 50), region?: "header" \| "footer" } \| Record<locale, string (max 200)[] (≤50)>> |  |

Output: { scenes: ({ id: string (min 1, max 36), pageId: string (min 1, max 36), versionId: string (min 1, max 50), trigger: { type: "scroll", anchor: … \| …, start: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, end?: { edge: …, viewport: …, offset?: …, belowHeader?: … }, endAnchor?: { nodeId: …, part: …, region?: … },… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","recipeId":"dock","knobs":{"target":{"nodeId":"mark0001","part":"root"},"slot":{"nodeId":"logo0001","part":"root","region":"header"},"start":0.95,"duration":0.75}}
```

> Read the recipes and their knobs first (`motion.listRecipes` or the `motion` resource). After applying, the answer's `motion.*` findings name scene problems (hidden-at-rest, overlap...): fix them before finishing.

## motion.saveRecipe

Save scenes of a page that one recipe built as a site recipe (`site:<key>`): the scenes, their source recipe and its knobs, under a label in Italian and English. A site recipe has no knobs of its own; applying it writes its scenes again.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `presets`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |
| `sceneIds` | string (min 1, max 36)[] (≤20) | yes |
| `label` | object | yes |
| `label.it` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `label.en` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `description` | object |  |
| `description.it` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `description.en` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |

Output: { id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, description: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, source: "built-in" \| "site", knobs: ({ id: string, label: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: string (min 1, max 120) }, help?: { it: string (min 1, max 120), en: … (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","sceneIds":["scene-1"],"label":{"it":"Logo che si aggancia","en":"Docking logo"}}
```

## motion.diagnose

Explain why a page's scenes would not play as authored: one finding per problem, each with a reason code (target-missing, target-ambiguous, stateful-target, overlap, empty-range, hidden-at-rest, never-matches), the scene and the node ref it concerns. overlap compares only scenes whose conditions can hold on one viewport: a sm-only scene and a md-up one never overlap.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) | yes |

Output: { findings: ({ sceneId: string (min 1, max 36), code: "target-missing" \| "target-ambiguous" \| "stateful-target" \| "overlap" \| "empty-range" \| "hidden-at-rest" \| "never-matches", ref?: { nodeId: string, part: string (max 50), region?: "header" \| "footer" }, message: string (min 1, max 500) })[] }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}
```
